items.exampleEn: He alleged that his neighbor had damaged his car.
items.exampleZh: 他聲稱是鄰居弄壞了他的車。

items.exampleEn: Your assertion is not supported by any facts.
items.exampleZh: 你的主張沒有任何事實根據。

items.exampleEn: One con of living downtown is the noise at night.
items.exampleZh: 住在市中心的一個缺點是晚上很吵。

items.exampleEn: The meaning of the poem is rather obscure.
items.exampleZh: 這首詩的意思相當晦澀難懂。
items.glossZh: 鮮為人知的、難懂的；遮蔽

items.exampleEn: She is a credible witness because she saw everything.
items.exampleZh: 她是可信的證人，因為她看到了整個經過。

items.exampleEn: Technology has profoundly changed the way we shop.
items.exampleZh: 科技深深地改變了我們購物的方式。

items.exampleEn: He is cynical about advertising and never believes it.
items.exampleZh: 他對廣告抱持懷疑，從來不相信。

items.exampleEn: The painter is famous for the realism of his flowers.
items.exampleZh: 這位畫家以畫花寫實而聞名。

items.sentenceEn: Is there any credible evidence for this claim?
items.sentenceZh: 這個說法有任何可信的證據嗎？

items.audioEn: The man alleged that the shop had charged him twice, but he had no receipt.
items.audioZh: 那位男士聲稱店家向他收了兩次錢，但他沒有收據。

items.sentenceEn: I was profoundly moved by the last scene of the film.
items.sentenceZh: 電影的最後一幕讓我深受感動。

items.sentenceEn: Thick clouds obscured the top of the mountain.
items.sentenceZh: 厚厚的雲層遮住了山頂。

items.stemEn: After so many broken promises, the residents were ____ when the landlord offered help again.
items.stemZh: 經歷過那麼多次食言之後，房東再次說要幫忙時，住戶們都抱持懷疑。

items.stemEn: Her ____ that the earth is flat surprised the whole class.
items.stemZh: 她斷言地球是平的，讓全班都很驚訝。

items.passageEn: My book club recently read a novel by an obscure writer from a small coastal town. The story follows a cynical journalist who alleges that the town's biggest hotel has been pouring waste into the sea. The truth remains elusive until the last page. Some members found the book slow, and one of the cons they mentioned was its long descriptions of the sea. Still, most of us were impressed by its realism. The characters speak and act like real people, and the ending profoundly moved several readers. The writer's main assertion seems to be that small towns protect their secrets.
items.passageZh: 我們讀書會最近讀了一本小說，作者是來自一個海邊小鎮、沒沒無聞的作家。故事描寫一位憤世嫉俗的記者，指控鎮上最大的飯店一直把廢水排進海裡。真相直到最後一頁之前都難以捉摸。有些成員覺得這本書節奏很慢，他們提到的缺點之一是描寫大海的段落太長。儘管如此，我們大多數人都很欣賞它的寫實。角色說話和行為都像真實的人，結局也深深打動了好幾位讀者。作者的主要論點似乎是：小鎮會守護自己的祕密。

questions.questionZh: 有些成員提到這本書的缺點是什麼？
大多數成員欣賞這本書的什麼？

items.promptZh: 你能說說這個計畫的優缺點嗎？
referenceEn: Can you tell me the pros and cons of this plan?
Could you explain the pros and cons of the plan?
rubricZh: pros and cons 表示「優缺點」（con 指缺點，例如 the pros and cons、the cons 等）
「說說」可寫，例如 tell me、explain、talk about 等

items.instructionZh: 用 realism 造一個句子，說說你欣賞某部作品或某個人的哪一點。
referenceEn: I admire the realism of this film because it shows daily life honestly.
I admire my mother's realism; she always plans for possible problems.
rubricZh: realism 可表示「寫實」或「務實的態度」（例如 the realism of the film、my mother's realism 等）
句子要說出你自己的看法

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：q14 混合詞性題只有一個干擾項放得進名詞空格
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: cynical 換成同單元名詞 scrutiny；realism、scrutiny 放得進 Her ____ that… 但語意不通
